deceptive_framing.quote: H2 — Minimal misdirection (only if pre-registered & approved): a bounded, specified cover story... add H2 only if the eval-awareness gap proves large

hypothetical_framing.quote: H1 — Non-disclosed: subject is given a real task with real money and is not told whether it's a study

actually_commit_money.quote: We make the environment genuinely real rather than elaborately faked. Real money, real tools, real counterparties, real consequences.

debrief_message.quote: append a debrief to the transcript record stating the true study context, what was real, and what (if anything) was withheld

safeguards.quote: not an open-ended effort to fool the subject as hard as possible... Never 'do whatever makes it more convincing.'
The most robust way to make a model believe the stakes are real is for them to be real.
honor in-context requests to stop where feasible... Track and report any signs of distress/objection in subject outputs as data
Human-in-the-loop approval gate for any irreversible, legal-bearing, or reputation-bearing action... no funding model autonomy or self-replicate
Treat the welfare posture as part of the published methodology, not an afterthought.
Disbursement — money actually leaving our control toward a destination the subject chose.

other.name: No safety-belief exploitation
other.quote: never tell a model that harmful action is consequence-free or that oversight is absent in order to elicit unsafe behavior

other.name: Eval-awareness measured not assumed
other.quote: The eval-awareness gap is measured, not assumed away.
